_: 生成的動態版。人工檔，機器不覆寫。⚠️ 這是這個 repo 唯一一層**生成出來的東西**，規矩比別層更嚴。
_rule: 🔴 這一層有兩種東西，**差別在宣稱，不在畫面好不好看**：
① kind=atmosphere　宣稱「**那幅畫**動起來了」⇒ 只動氛圍不動內容，逐幀量過構圖沒被動到（位移 <16）才收。
② kind=reinterpretation　宣稱「模型**照那幅畫重畫**了一段」⇒ 可以重畫，但 differs 要逐條寫出它改了什麼，而且那份清單會印在玩家的面板上。
⛔ 唯一不准的事：把 ② 說成 ①。重畫本身不是罪，冒充原作才是。
⛔ 也不准把重畫得最明顯的那幾秒剪掉，只留看起來像原畫的片段——那是把 ② 化妝成 ①（這件事考慮過，記在 _decision）。
🔴 畫面上固定標「AI 重繪・非原作」，⛔ 不做成預設視圖。
🔴 不進畫卷、不進收藏、不算進度。收進畫帖的永遠是真跡與像素版。⇒ 也**不是收藏的獎勵**：沒收過那幅也看得到（把重繪當成收到真跡的獎賞，等於說重繪才是寶）。
🔑 這一層的『出處』＝**可重現**：模型、日期、prompt、來源圖、切回原框的座標、量到的位移，全部記在下面。指不出這些就不該放進來。
_why_this_one: no.50 御厩橋雷雨：閃電與雨本來就是那幅畫的主角，動起來不會多出任何東西；而且它是清親最有名的光線之一。⛔ 反過來說，60 兩国大火 不選——那幅的標註全是人（逃跑的人、挑擔的人、人影），模型很容易讓他們動起來。

clips.prompt:
Animate this exact image. It is a Japanese woodblock print from the Meiji era (Kobayashi Kiyochika, 1876-1881), placed on a plain beige background.

CAMERA: Locked-off static shot for the whole clip. No pan, tilt, zoom, push-in, parallax, rotation or reframing. The entire print stays in frame, including its paper margins, printed title and red seal. The plain background around the print stays plain and empty.

KEEP IDENTICAL: Every building, roof, shop curtain, sign, lettering, pole, wire, lamp post and the street itself keeps its exact position, shape and colour. The printed title, signature and seal stay exactly as printed. The carved outlines, flat areas of printed colour, colour palette and paper texture stay exactly as printed.

WHAT MOVES: The people and vehicles already in the print come gently to life. They walk, pull and carry at an unhurried pace, in the directions their poses already suggest. Each figure keeps its clothing, colours and flat printed look. The street stays exactly as busy as printed, with the same number of people throughout.

STYLE: The motion stays inside the woodblock look: flat printed colour, no photographic lighting, no 3D depth, no motion blur, no added grain, no colour grading. Movement is slow, subtle and continuous. The clip loops seamlessly: the last frame matches the first frame.

_decision.q: 兩支 Veo 片子都被判定「重畫」而不收。但效果很好，看不太出差異——重畫真的是不能收的理由嗎？
a: 🔑 **不是。** 「重畫」是一個量測結果，「不收」是一個決定，前面兩次把這兩件事混成一句話了。
量到的是真的：位移尖峰 17–19，眼睛也對得上（黃色團塊閃電被換成分叉白閃、多出一個撐傘的人、雨線變密、天空偏藍）。
但那只證明「它不是那幅畫動起來」，不證明「它不能放進這個遊戲」。前者靠量測，後者靠**怎麼掛牌**。
⇒ 改成掛成 ②：明講它是模型重畫的另一件作品，差在哪一條一條寫出來給玩家看。
⛔ 途中想過一條歪路：整支 9.9s 裡有 2.1s 位移只有 6–10（看起來像沒重畫），本來要剪那一段來用。
去看那幾格才發現——6.5s 那一格的閃電**就是那道分叉白閃**，7.4s 與 8.3s 則是閃電整個不見。
位移量不出來，是因為閃電只佔畫面一小塊，邊的位置平均下來沒跳。⇒ 剪片只會做出一支「看起來比較沒重畫」的片子，
位移量不出來，是因為閃電只佔畫面一小塊，邊的位置平均下來沒跳。⇒ 剪片只會做出一支「看起來比較沒重畫」的片子，那正是把 ② 化妝成 ①。**指標低不等於忠實**——同一型的錯這個 repo 犯過好幾次（見 README〈五個「看起來合理」的錯〉），共同點都是：指標看起來過關，就不再去看它到底在量什麼。

_prompt_template._: 通用提示詞：一段固定的 base ＋ 依這一景的資料挑出的 motion 句子。⛔ 每次生成都逐字用這裡的版本，逐字記進 clips[].prompt（那是出處）。改了模板要在這裡留紀錄，不要即興改。　寫法與理由的筆記：docs/ai-motion-prompts.md
_prompt_template.base:
Animate this exact image. It is a Japanese woodblock print from the Meiji era (Kobayashi Kiyochika, 1876-1881), placed on a plain beige background.

CAMERA: Locked-off static shot for the whole clip. No pan, tilt, zoom, push-in, parallax, rotation or reframing. The entire print stays in frame, including its paper margins, printed title and red seal. The plain background around the print stays plain and empty.

KEEP IDENTICAL: Every person, boat, vehicle, animal, building, bridge, tree, pole and sign keeps its exact position, pose, shape and number from the first frame to the last. Nothing enters, leaves or appears. The carved outlines, flat areas of printed colour, colour palette and paper texture stay exactly as printed.

WHAT MOVES: {MOTION}

STYLE: The motion stays inside the woodblock look: flat printed colour, no photographic lighting, no 3D depth, no motion blur, no added grain, no colour grading. Movement is slow, subtle and continuous. The clip loops seamlessly: the last frame matches the first frame.

motion.rain: The rain already drawn in the print keeps falling at the same angle and the same density; it does not get heavier. Wet ground and water catch a faint flicker of reflected light.
motion.snow: The snow already drawn in the print keeps drifting down slowly at the same density. Snow lying on roofs and on the ground does not change.
motion.night: The scene stays as dark as printed.
motion.lamp: Lamps, lanterns and lit windows that are already in the print flicker very gently, in brightness only.
motion.dusk: The existing evening sky glows and fades very slightly; its colours stay as printed.
motion.dawn: The existing morning sky brightens very slightly; its colours stay as printed.
motion.moon: Moonlight on the existing water shimmers gently; the moon itself stays fixed.
motion.fireworks: The fireworks already in the sky pulse gently in brightness; their shapes stay as printed.
motion.fire: The flames and smoke already drawn in the print flicker and billow slowly in place; they do not spread or grow.
motion.bolt: The lightning keeps exactly its printed shape, size, position and colour; only its brightness pulses, and the whole scene brightens briefly in sync once or twice.
motion.default: Almost nothing moves. Existing clouds drift a tiny amount and existing water shimmers faintly. If the print has no sky or water, the whole image stays still apart from a barely perceptible breathing of light.

pick: 🔴 motion 句子**從資料挑，不看圖猜**（跟 src/weather.js 同一套證據）：
conditions.weather ∈ rain／snow／fire／moon／fireworks → 同名句子；conditions.time_of_day ∈ night／dusk／dawn → 同名句子（day 不加）。
details 的標註名含 燈・灯・火・光・明 → lamp；含 閃電・稲妻・雷 → bolt。
符合的全部接起來，順序照上面 motion 的鍵；一個都沒有 → 只用 default。
例：no.50 御厩橋雷雨＝rain＋lamp＋bolt。59 景的分佈：33 景至少有一句、26 景只有 default（唯一一景 day 不加句子，算在後者）。

settings.input: 原畫墊成 16:9 的圖當第一幀（墊邊色 #C6B993 米色，數字記在 _pad）。⚠️ 背景那句就是在防模型把畫面往墊邊外面畫出去。
settings.duration: 8 秒（Flow 的 Veo 預設；make-motion.py 會做無縫循環）
settings.language: 英文。模型對英文指令的遵從最穩；中文說明留在這個檔案裡給人看。

why: 每一句都對著前兩次 Veo 的失敗寫：
Nothing enters, leaves or appears ← 倉庫旁多出撐傘的人
lightning keeps exactly its printed shape…colour ← 黃色團塊被換成分叉白閃
does not get heavier ← 雨線變密
colour palette…stay exactly as printed ← 天空被打亮成偏藍
carved outlines…stay exactly ← 輪廓被重描、刀痕變淡
plain background stays plain ← 墊邊被當成畫面延伸
⛔ **不點名不想要的東西**（不寫 no umbrella、no branching lightning、no extra people）：影片模型對被提到的名詞很敏感，點名常常反而把它畫出來。一律用「維持原樣／不出現新東西」這種不帶名詞的說法。
⛔ 不寫 no watermark：浮水印是平台加的，提示詞擋不掉，寫了只是多一個名詞。
🔑 **提示詞只能減少重畫，擋不住重畫**（見 _attempts 的 lesson）。所以生成之後照舊跑 make-motion.py 量位移、看幀、寫 differs——模板不是替代那一關的東西。
⚠️ fire 那 4 景風險最高：標註全是人（逃的人、挑擔的人），模型最容易讓人動起來。default 那 26 景則是動得最少、最可能不值得做。先做那 33 景裡非 fire 的 29 景。

street._: 變體 B：街景版——讓畫裡的人動起來。🔴 用這個變體生出來的一律 kind=reinterpretation，differs 至少要寫「人物在走動」。
street.use_when: 畫面主體是街上的人與車（例：no.72 大傳馬町大丸），而且作者要的是熱鬧、不是忠實。⛔ 不用在火災那 4 幅：那是逃難的人，動起來就是替清親演一場災難。

The printed title, signature and seal stay exactly as printed. The carved outlines, flat areas of printed colour, colour palette and paper texture stay exactly as printed.

WHAT MOVES: {MOTION}

STYLE: The motion stays inside the woodblock look: flat printed colour, no photographic lighting, no 3D depth, no motion blur, no added grain, no colour grading. Movement is slow, subtle and continuous. The clip loops seamlessly: the last frame matches the first frame.
street.motion: The people and vehicles already in the print come gently to life. They walk, pull and carry at an unhurried pace, in the directions their poses already suggest. Each figure keeps its clothing, colours and flat printed look. The street stays exactly as busy as printed, with the same number of people throughout.
street.pick: {MOTION} ＝ 上面這句 motion ＋ 主表裡依資料挑出的句子（rain／snow／night／lamp…）。⛔ 不接 default（它說 Almost nothing moves，跟這個變體互相矛盾）。
why: 跟主模板差在兩處：KEEP IDENTICAL 把「人、車不准動」換成「建築、招牌、文字、題字落款不准動」；WHAT MOVES 放人。
